hypothesis: Prior-only Q90 seven-family behaviour state adds predictive information about next-target Q7 quintet-universe rank quality beyond the frozen Q7+Q80 cross-granularity baseline.
estimand: Target-level mean normalized percentile of the realized quintet across the fixed 1,023 Q7 quintet_score formulas; 0.5 is the random-quintet reference. This is a meta-quality forecast, not a winning-number or winning-quintet prediction.

baseline_m1.name: Q7+Q80
baseline_m1.role: Primary comparator; same fixed feature construction as Q141-C4.

walkforward.discovery_predictions: Expanding prequential fits; each target is predicted before its outcome is available.
walkforward.holdout_policy: Fit coefficients at the end of Discovery and freeze them for Validation and Blind OOS; rolling feature state may update only after each target is scored.
walkforward.q90_sample_policy: Use the fixed, outcome-independent Q141-B7 sample of 100 formulas per Q90 family (700/330429); do not resample or select formulas on this experiment.

primary_endpoint.statistic: mean(abs_error_M1) - mean(abs_error_M2); positive favours adding Q90

inference.multiplicity: One confirmatory primary endpoint (M2 versus M1); M2 versus M0 and all atlas correlations are descriptive only. No data-driven endpoint switching.
